t: Mains-powered CO alarm with 9V replaceable battery backup. Designed for use in living spaces such as kitchens as well as attics, garages and any room with a fuel burning appliance. Easy to install with push-fit base. Can be hardwire interlinked with up to 12 x SW1-R smoke alarms and/or HW1 heat alarms; alternatively, it can be used with RF-BW-T base to wirelessly interlink multiple alarms (sold separately). Not suitable for residential properties in Scotland. Please refer to guidance.
